exposure: admission for delivery during early labor
Women living in Canada less than 2 years
cohort: Migrant women from low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) living in Canada less than 8 years, who gave birth at one of three Montreal hospitals between March 2014 and January 2015.
finding: Migrant women from sub-Saharan Africa/Caribbean and recently arrived migrant women with a humanitarian classification were at greater risk for unplanned cesareans compared with other low-risk migrant women from LMICs after controlling for medical factors.
mod_finding: This study found that migrant women from sub-Saharan Africa/Caribbean and recently arrived migrant women with a humanitarian classification are at greater risk for unplanned cesareans compared with other low-risk migrant women.
